data_description.openai_api_key: Leave blank in Configure to keep the saved key.
data_description.spotify_client_secret: Leave blank to keep the saved secret.
data_description.agent_model: Model used by the Python agent for delegated work. Terra is a balanced starting point; Luna costs less; Sol and Astra offer more capability. Live speech keeps its separate voice model.
data_description.reasoning_effort: Low is recommended for voice latency. An effort unsupported by the selected model is saved as low.
data_description.fast_mode: Requests OpenAI Fast processing at higher token rates (currently 2x for the new models). Off explicitly requests standard processing. This cannot speed up external tools.
data_description.session_timeout_minutes: Controls stored Python-agent conversation context. The Voice listening idle timeout is set separately in the Special Agent Live app.
data_description.enable_performance_tracking: Optional detailed diagnostics. Concise activity logs are available in Home Assistant Core without this setting.
data_description.scene_memory_enabled: Learn and reuse routines in Special Agent scene_memory.json. These are separate from Home Assistant scenes.yaml.
